propositions: Project-configured code-review criteria merge successfully into the overlay but never execute at runtime, appearing as silent failures indistinguishable from rubrics with no findings.
Project-id-agnostic code-review runtime must execute activated project criteria exactly once per review using the same plan-review fan-in pattern without modifying the versioned workflow schema.
Project prompt and eval assets must resolve from the reviewed repository snapshot, and missing or malformed assets must raise a fatal LLMError before model execution rather than silently skipping.
Logical project criterion IDs must map to sanitized physical prompt IDs (code-review-project-*), with findings rewritten to retain only logical IDs for Pass 3 routing decisions.
Pass 3 decision logic must apply repository-effective thresholds, blocking posture, and nit-suppression using the same routing registry without adding LLM invocations.
